title: upgradescope webhook notification, schemaVersion 1
description: The JSON body `upgradescope serve --webhook` POSTs: every readiness change one evaluation pass found for one cluster. Fields may be added within schemaVersion 1, so the schema allows unknown fields: ignore them. A rename or removal bumps schemaVersion. internal/server/webhook_schema_test.go validates real deliveries against this file and fails on a field it does not list.

deliveryId.description: The same on every retry and for every sink: deduplicate on it. 32 hex characters; outbox-<n> for a message a server older than this format queued.

type.description: The event type. The set is closed: a new type bumps schemaVersion (docs/compatibility-policy.md).

timestamp.description: When the evaluation pass ran, RFC 3339 UTC.

targets.description: The verdict after the pass of every target with a change.

changes.description: The findings delta, ordered new-blocker, became-ready, eol-approaching. A change worded the same for several targets is one entry listing them.

key.description: The finding's stable key; absent for became-ready.

omitted.description: Changes left out by the per-kind cap (5), by kind. Absent when nothing was left out.
